dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, what are people doing in the park?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈwʌt ər ˈpiːpəl ˈduːɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A man is running, and two girls are riding bikes.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmæn ɪz ˈrʌnɪŋ, ənd ˈtuː ˈɡɜːrlz ər ˈraɪdɪŋ ˈbaɪks.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: They're flying a kite. It's very windy today!
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈflaɪɪŋ ə ˈkaɪt. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈwɪndi təˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, a woman is walking her dog. It's cute!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ə ˈwʊmən ɪz ˈwɔːkɪŋ hɜːr ˈdɔːɡ. ɪts ˈkjuːt!
